inspiration: Syllable-built spells: a spell is a root verb plus modifier bricks (power level, range, area). The brick table has 8 roots, 27 modifiers and 18 suffix bricks, each with a short made-up syllable (ryzom/client/data/gamedev/bricks_client.txt lines 2-53). Copy the composition rule, not the names.

Viewpoint combat feed: one message key per event, separate text for you-attack, hit-you and other-vs-other, a colour prefix per line type, placeholders for names (ryzom/common/data_common/chat/bs_combat.txt lines 5-7). Clean shape for a 375-wide combat log.

Lob projectile: a fixed-duration flight. Horizontal position is a linear blend from start to end; a sine lift adds height that grows with the square of throw distance (snowballs2/server/position/snowballs/position/physics.cpp lines 32-35). Reads as a throw without a physics sim.

Map landmark actions as a data list: rows of id, label key and handler for target, teleport, rename, remove, create and search (ryzom/client/data/gamedev/interfaces_v3/map.xml lines 12-32). Good shape for a data-driven world-map action row.

Lift derivative defect (keep the idea): evalSpeed (physics.cpp lines 41-44) does not divide the lift term by the flight time, and takes horizontal speed from a separate _Speed. Fix: derive both from one flight duration and clamp at the arc end.

briefs.label: Syllable-built ability
briefs.why: Readable at 375 wide as a three-slot picker: verb, power, area. One signature behaviour: the ability name is assembled from the picks, so a build reads like a word.
briefs.keep: KEPT: one root verb plus modifier slots (power, range, area); short made-up syllables.
briefs.change: CHANGED: our own syllables and verb set; three tap-chips on a phone, not a text string; the area slot shows a ring preview.

briefs.label: Viewpoint combat line
briefs.why: One signature effect: the same event reads differently to you, to the target and to a bystander, in one colour per kind of line.
briefs.keep: KEPT: separate templates for you-attack, hit-you and other-vs-other; placeholders for names.
briefs.change: CHANGED: our own colour set (no donor colour codes); shorter lines for 375 wide; a small icon before each line in place of a colour prefix.

briefs.label: Lob arc throw
briefs.why: Silhouette: a high, readable arc that is taller for longer throws. One signature sound: a soft whoosh on release and a splat on landing.
briefs.keep: KEPT: lift grows with the square of distance; sine arc over a fixed flight time.
briefs.change: CHANGED: a shorter flight and a lift cap; a ground shadow ring under the arc; speed and lift derived from one flight duration (the donor's defect fixed).

briefs.label: Landmark action row
briefs.why: Data-driven map actions read as a short verb row, so the map UI stays one shape for every landmark.
briefs.keep: KEPT: the landmark actions as a list of id, label key and handler.
briefs.change: CHANGED: a bottom sheet with three verbs on phone; different ids and labels; our own search flow.
